title: Product Platform Engineer
description:
Skills –
**Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka / Amazon MSK, AWS and Azure cloud platforms, distributed data processing, data architecture, Docker, cloud storage (AWS S3 / Azure Blob), NoSQL databases, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, observability**

Job Description -

* 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Apache Flink for distributed batch and real-time stream processing.
* Strong understanding of Apache Kafka / Amazon MSK, including topics, partitions, producers, consumers, consumer groups, retries and failure handling.
* Practical exposure to AWS and Azure cloud services, including AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage and cloud-based data integration.
* Understanding of data architecture patterns, including Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver and Gold layers).
* Experience with NoSQL databases and analytical data modelling concepts, including star-schema modelling.
* Understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous communication, API design and distributed systems.

As a Product Platform Engineer, you will:

* Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native platform components across AWS and Azure.
* Build event-driven ingestion and processing pipelines using MSK/Kafka, Flink, Spark, or AWS Glue.
* Implement reliable data movement across streaming, processing, and cloud storage layers such as S3 and Azure Blob Storage.
* Containerize services using Docker and support deployment into managed container platforms.
* Design microservices with clear boundaries, asynchronous communication, resilience, security, observability, and production supportability.
* Apply Medallion Architecture patterns across bronze, silver, and gold data layers.
* Use NoSQL databases appropriately and support analytical models where starschema patterns are required.To adhere to ISMS policiesand procedures
* Integrate AI/ML or GenAI services into enterprise applications through secure, governed, and observable interfaces.
* Collaborate with application, data, infrastructure, security, and AI/ML teams to deliver reusable platform capabilities.

**Engineering Practices:**

* API-first and event-driven design, including idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, and replayability.
* Infrastructure as Code and automated CI/CD practices; Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent exposure is desirable.
* Cloud security fundamentals: identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network controls, and least privilege.
* Observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.
* Unit, integration, contract, and performance testing for cloud and distributed workloads.
* Clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and design-decision records.

**Preferred / Desirable Skills:**

* Kubernetes, Amazon ECS/EKS, or Azure Kubernetes Service experience.
* Azure Event Hubs, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, or Azure Databricks exposure.
* AWS Lambda, ECS/Fargate, IAM, CloudWatch, Step Functions, and API Gateway exposure.
* Experience with schema management, data quality, lineage, metadata, governance, or catalog services.
* Understanding of distributed-system trade-offs, performance tuning, cost optimization, and production incident troubleshooting.

**RAG Architecture & Use Case Integration**

* Design and implement RAG layers for Cyncly's five LLM use cases, ensuring context relevance, faithfulness, and latency targets; integrate MCP connectors to expose internal data sources and product APIs to the LLM inference layer.

**Role Overview**

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey.

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance.

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights.

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content.
* Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators.
* Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria.
* Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data.
* Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance.
* Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles.
* Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly.
* Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement.
* Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

* Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets.
* Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency.
* Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems.
* Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.
